onboarding.tagline: Chat, plan and share with the people you trust.
onboarding.privacyNote: End-to-end encrypted. No phone number required. Your identity stays on this device.
onboarding.nameHelp: This is what your friends will see. You can change it later.

settings.title: Settings
settings.shareCodeHelp: Let a friend scan this to add you.
settings.identityCreated: Identity created {{date}}. Your private key never leaves this device.
settings.appearanceHelp: Pick an accent colour and a light or dark canvas. Changes apply instantly.
settings.languageHelp: Choose the language for the app. Languages without a complete translation fall back to English.
settings.readReceiptsHelp: When off, your peers can't tell when you read their messages. Both sides need this on for either to see receipts.
settings.typingIndicatorHelp: Symmetric — when on, you send typing pings AND see peers'. When off, neither side does.
settings.notificationsHelp: Control which events raise a notification. The OS permission must be granted first.
settings.notifPermissionDenied: Notifications blocked — enable them in your device settings
settings.notifChannelDmsHelp: A new message in a one-to-one chat.
settings.notifChannelEventsHelp: Upcoming events you've been invited to.
settings.storageHelp: On-device storage used by the app. Clearing the cache won't delete your identity or messages.
settings.clearCacheHelp: Removes the offline portal cache and other rebuildable data.
settings.deleteConfirm: Sign out? This will permanently delete your identity and all messages on this device. This cannot be undone.
settings.paymentDetailsSub: Your name and address for payment records
settings.moneyProfileSub: Your usual money pattern — helps spot unusual payments
settings.activityReviewSub: Your spending pattern and any flagged payments

paymentDetails.title: Payment details
paymentDetails.subtitle: Your name and address are added to the ISO 20022 record of every payment you make. All fields are optional.
paymentDetails.name: Full name
paymentDetails.privacyNote: These details stay on this phone. They are only used to fill the payment record — ANTON never sends them anywhere on its own.

moneyProfile.title: Money profile
moneyProfile.subtitle: A private picture of who you are and what your normal money pattern looks like. ANTON uses it to flag payments that look unusual for you. Every field is optional.
moneyProfile.sourceOfFunds: Where your money mainly comes from
moneyProfile.privacyNote: This is a personal record kept only on this phone. ANTON never sends it anywhere. It is not an identity check — it is the baseline the app compares new payments against.

fraud.payAnywayHint: Tap again only if you're sure this payment is right.

signal.amount-anomaly: About {{factor}}× larger than your usual payment.
signal.above-typical: About {{factor}}× larger than the typical payment size you set.
signal.new-counterparty: You've never paid this recipient before.
signal.new-counterparty-large: A large payment to a recipient you've never paid before.
signal.velocity: {{count}} payments already in the last 24 hours.
signal.monthly-cap: This pushes your 30-day spending past the {{expected}} FTC you expect to spend in a month.
signal.odd-hour: You don't usually make payments at this time of day.
signal.expiring-qr: This code is about to expire — don't let anyone rush you.
signal.dormancy-break: Your first payment in {{days}} days, and a large one.

activityReview.title: Activity review
activityReview.subtitle: A look back at your spending pattern and any payments ANTON flagged as unusual for you.
activityReview.emptyBody: Payments that look unusual for you will show up here.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.setupExplain: We'll generate a secp256k1 keypair on this device. The private key never leaves your phone — it lives in the device keychain.
wallet.setupAddressNote: Your address is what merchants scan to charge you. It's public — share freely.
wallet.taxHint: Tap Tax for an estimated position based on your declared residency. Per FutureChain's tax policy this is an estimate only — see the disclaimer on the tax screen.
wallet.receiveHelp: Show this code to whoever's paying you. They scan it with their wallet to pick the amount.
wallet.sendHelp: Paste a merchant's futurechain:pay link, or a recipient's address.
wallet.sendV0Note: v0: this records the tx for your ledger. Network broadcast lands with the FutureChain RPC client.

sendErr.bareAddress: Bare addresses need an amount. Paste a futurechain:pay link.
sendErr.badAmount: Amount must be a positive integer (micro-FTC).

iso.title: ISO 20022 payment details
iso.note: This payment maps to an ISO 20022 PACS.008 credit transfer. Add your details in Settings → Payment details.

tax.title: Tax
tax.residencyHelp: Pick the country you're tax resident in. We use this to apply the right rules — it stays on this device.
tax.residencyDeclared: Per FutureChain's tax policy, residency is declared, not inferred from your location. Re-confirm yearly or whenever it changes. If you live in multiple countries during the year, talk to a tax adviser — Anton doesn't split jurisdictions.
tax.estimateOnly: Estimate only — not a tax bill. See disclaimer below.
tax.setResidencyPrompt: Set your tax residency to see your position.
tax.unsupportedHistoryNote: Your transaction history is still available on the wallet History tab. A CSV export landing soon will let you hand the raw ledger to your adviser.
tax.staleNote: These rules were last verified more than {{days}} days ago. Re-verification is overdue — surfaced numbers may not reflect current law.
tax.emtEnabledNote: Your jurisdiction has an EMT carve-out — flipping this toggle changes the rate applied to your disposals (per §7.2 of FutureChain's tax policy).
tax.emtDisabledNote: Your jurisdiction has no published EMT carve-out, so flipping this toggle won't change today's rate. The classification still rides with the report so an adviser can argue for relief.
tax.reasonAboveThreshold: Estimated tax is above {{threshold}} — consult an adviser before filing.
tax.reportNoDisposals: No disposals this year — exports will contain a header and the §3 disclaimer only.
tax.reportHandOff: Hand the CSV to your tax adviser as a pre-filing draft. Every export carries the §3 disclaimer at the top.
tax.reportUnsupported: Tax calculation for {{name}} is not currently supported in this version. You can still export the raw transaction ledger below for your adviser.

chat.title: Chat
chat.noContactsHelp: Tap + to add a friend by scanning their QR or pasting their contact code.
chat.scanHelp: Hold the camera over a friend's ANTON contact QR.
chat.cameraUnavailable: Camera not available. Try the "Paste code" tab instead.
chat.errNotContactCode: Not a valid ANTON contact code
chat.errCodeMismatch: Contact code does not match the embedded key
chat.namePlaceholder: How you'll see them in your chat list
chat.errInvalidCode: That doesn't look like a valid ANTON contact code (ANTON-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX).
chat.addByCodeNote: Adding by code alone doesn't include the friend's public key. Their key will be fetched automatically the first time you message them.
chat.noPeerKey: You don't have this contact's public key yet. Ask them to share their QR.
chat.startConversation: Start the conversation — messages here are end-to-end encrypted.
chat.videoTooBig: Video is too big ({{size}}). Try a shorter clip — the limit is roughly 700 KB after compression.
chat.imageTooBig: Image is too big ({{size}}). Try a smaller photo.
chat.closeToDelete: Close to delete. The sender will see "Viewed".

events.title: Events
events.emptyToday: Nothing on the calendar for today.
events.emptyHelp: Tap + to create one and invite friends.
events.noContactsToInvite: No contacts to invite yet. Add a friend first to invite them.
events.reminderUnset: Off — pick a lead-time to get a local notification on this device.
events.errNotifOff: Notifications are off for the app. Enable them in system settings to use reminders.

wassup.title: Wassup
wassup.noPostsHelp: Tap + to share something with your contacts. Posts disappear after 24 hours by default.
wassup.errImageTooBig: Image is too big after compression — try a smaller photo.
wassup.errVoiceTooLong: Voice note is too long — try keeping it under a minute.
wassup.errEmptyPost: Add some text, a photo, or a voice note.
wassup.noComments: No comments yet. Be the first.

portals.title: Portals
portals.subtitle: Browse and visit ANTON portals.
portals.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, tag or area
portals.noPortalsHelp: Try a different search term or clear the filter chips.
portals.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again later.
portals.offlineCached: Offline — showing the last cached copy. Publisher is unreachable.
portals.useActionsBelow: You can still use the actions below.
